title: Game review
paste_hint: Paste a PGN — from GoodWorker, Lichess or chess.com.
bad_pgn: Couldn't read this game. Check that it is a PGN and every move in it is legal.
game_not_found: This game doesn't exist or isn't available to you.
game_login: Sign in to review this online game.
game_error: Couldn't load the game. Check your connection and try again.
game_empty: This game has no moves yet — nothing to review.
engine_down: The engine didn't load in this browser, and the review can't run without it.
no_analysis: The engine couldn't evaluate one of the positions. Try the review again.
graph_label: Evaluation graph: the higher the light area, the better for White
no_key: No key moments — a level game.
coach_idle: Paste a game — I'll go through every move and show where it was decided.
coach_analysing: Going through the game move by move…
coach_start: Done. Step through the moves with the arrows or click the graph — I'll comment on each one.
say_brilliant: {played} — a brilliant sacrifice! Material given up for the attack, and it's the strongest line.
say_great: {played} — a great move: the only one that holds the position.
say_best: {played} — the best move in this position.
say_excellent: {played} — excellent, almost as good as the best.
say_good: {played} — a good move. {best} was slightly more accurate.
say_miss: {played} — a miss: your opponent slipped, and {best} would have taken the advantage.
say_blunder: {played} — a blunder, the position is badly damaged. {best} would have saved it.
